title: lift-report template variables
description: Values for templates/lift-report.md.j2 and templates/lift-report.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from lift-report.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

call_site.title: Call site
call_site.description: Which call site does this lift report cover? One site per report - a pattern that lifts one site and sinks another is invisible in an average.

candidate_pattern.title: Candidate pattern
candidate_pattern.description: Which advanced pattern is being tried against zero-shot CoT? Name one - two changes at once makes the delta unattributable.

eval_set_path.title: Eval set path
eval_set_path.description: Where does the eval set live? A path a reader can open and re-run, so the delta below can be disputed with evidence rather than opinion.

sample_size.description: How many cases are in that eval set? Under about fifty a three-point accuracy delta is noise, and the keep decision below rests on exactly that number.
